pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Verse 1]
Shadows trembling in the snow
Thorns in every word you said to me
I couldn’t bring myself to speak at all
Frozen inside your misunderstanding
Sighs leaking through the cracks between us
Slowly erased the names we used to share
It’s love, I know it’s love
So why do we keep missing each other like this?

[Chorus]
We love each other so much it hurts
But even our truth became a wall between us
Standing in front of you with a locked voice
I kept saying “no, no”
Over and over again

[Verse 2]
“Please believe me” sank heavy in my chest
All the words that should have bloomed turned into tears
It’s love, because it’s love
I hesitated every time, afraid of losing you

[Chorus]
Did that single word inside your love
Cut you like a blade as we crossed each other?
The more I tried to explain, the deeper the misunderstanding
The tighter I held on, the farther you slipped away

[Bridge]
But it’s still you, it’s always been you
My heart still holds even your misunderstandings
I cry because I love you, cry until I’m empty
This foolish lover is still standing right here

[Chorus]
Just once, only once
Let me be reflected in your heart as I am
So we, who believed even misunderstanding was love
Can face each other again as love

[Outro]
Even the broken words, even the hurting faces
Let us admit they were all love
Let’s love again
Please… let’s love again
pkg.sunoStyle:
Trendy pop with a soft, energetic groove. Modern, fresh and emotional.
Male-female duet vocals throughout. Alternating lines, natural vocal interplay, gentle harmonies, clear and expressive vocals. Keep both voices distinct and balanced.
Light and simple intro with soft harmony. Verses begin gently with light rhythm, subtle percussion and restrained bass. Pre-chorus gradually builds emotional tension through delicate textures and rhythmic movement, without sudden intensity.
Chorus adds warmth and energy with warm bass, gentle harmonies and a smooth rhythmic lift. Emotional and engaging, but controlled and never explosive.
Final section gradually reduces energy, returning to soft duet vocals and minimal accompaniment, ending calm and reflective.
Natural dynamics, warm tone, clean modern production. Avoid loud mastering, heavy bass, excessive drums, dense layers and aggressive instrumentation.
